# Code Anchors: Approved-Set Filing

- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — files the approved set, sequences it from the ordering block and reuses an already-filed epic on a re-run (#903)
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/create.ts` — files one issue per story as children of the epic, resolving the story target repository independently
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/planning-dir.ts` — the run folder the draft lives in, so filing commits nothing
